title: Tata Power results due; profit seen higher

timeline.title: Tata Power results due; profit seen higher
timeline.line: Estimates range from ₹1,010 crore to ₹1,420 crore for Q2 profit
more: Motilal Oswal sees adjusted profit up 54.3% to ₹1,420 crore
JM Financial sees adjusted PAT up 81% to ₹1,305.3 crore
Mundra losses are seen narrowing to about ₹150 crore
